edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”), subject to their approval and execution of this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a settlement amount to be agreed by the parties and stated in the final executed agreement (the “Settlement Amount”). Defendant shall pay the Settlement Amount by wire transfer within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, pursuant to wire instructions designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds shall Plaintiff’s release of Defendant become effective. The release is limited to claims arising from the Dispute and does not release any right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose those terms to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Each party shall inform advisers receiving such disclosures of the confidential nature of the information and instruct them to maintain its confidentiality, subject to these exceptions.
